property_summary: For any depositor address and any nonzero ether amount sent to deposit(), the contract's stored balances[msg.sender] increases by exactly the amount of ETH actually transferred into the contract (address(c).balance increases by that amount as well); the mutant that doubles the added amount makes balances[msg.sender] increase by twice the transferred ETH for some inputs, violating this equality.
change_summary: Added an extra assignment that doubles the incoming value before adding to the balance (changes observable balance after deposit).
